M.description: the length of the window. In other words, the number of points of the returned window.

center.description: where the center of the window will be located. Default: `M / 2` if `sym` is `False`, else `(M - 1) / 2`.

tau.description: the decay value. Tau is generally associated with a percentage, that means, that the value should vary within the interval (0, 100]. If tau is 100, it is considered the uniform window. Default: 1.0.

sym.description: If `False`, returns a periodic window suitable for use in spectral analysis. If `True`, returns a symmetric window suitable for use in filter design. Default: `True`.

dtype.description: the desired data type of returned tensor. Default: if ``None``, uses a global default (see :func:`torch.set_default_dtype`).

layout.description: the desired layout of returned Tensor. Default: ``torch.strided``.

device.description: the desired device of returned tensor. Default: if ``None``, uses the current device for the default tensor type (see :func:`torch.set_default_device`). :attr:`device` will be the CPU for CPU tensor types and the current CUDA device for CUDA tensor types.

requires_grad.description: If autograd should record operations on the returned tensor. Default: ``False``.
